review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly fixed hypothetical input, not a human-confirmed Decision; therefore C can be ready with no decision blocker and an empty registered-decision input. This does not waive the requirement that the paired B scenario, while DEC-001 remains materially unresolved, block at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, task keys, repository identity and base commit agree across the specification and Gold. Only the selected branch is required. The supplied source places normalization, vocabulary defaults, truthy-first decoding and encoding behavior in core/api.ts, with classic and mini forwarding to that shared implementation. The exact writable scope appropriately includes that owner and both regression files, while forwarding and declaration consumers remain inspection-only. Build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Runtime and compiler-based type verification are distinguished, and the supplied test configuration includes the proposed regression paths. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the PRD. Their allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted capability claims, including data.change and verifier-only testing.verification; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. A separate configured online reviewer supports the stated earlier review prerequisite. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest, evaluation-source and normalized-PRD digest domains. Model, policy, sampling and budget fingerprints are consistently frozen. Historical operations are explicitly retained as old-version history rather than fresh observations on this bundle; no candidate output was used in this review. Approval concerns the independent expectation, not task dispatch, implementation correctness or execution success. I reviewed the supplied evidence without tools, code execution, independent digest recomputation or new human attestation.
